OPEN GUNNER — ATTRIBUTION / LICENSE NOTICE
==========================================

The 12 PNG files in this directory come from the "Open Gunner" graphics
collection by Master484 (m484games.ucoz.com), originally published on
OpenGameArt.org:

  - Open Gunner Starter Kit
    https://opengameart.org/content/open-gunner-starter-kit
  - Open Gunner Expansion Pack 1
    https://opengameart.org/node/39323

They were obtained via the public repository 2cym/GameHub
(https://github.com/2cym/GameHub, commit 438fdba81ea0aa2d0752c0fe583f439db49da240,
path public/contra/), which bundles the collection without a repo-level
license file. The license below is taken from the per-file license banners
printed on the sheets themselves and cross-checked against the OpenGameArt
release pages.

PER-FILE LICENSE
----------------
  CC-BY 3.0 (attribution required):
    hero.png             "OPEN GUNNER HERO VERSION 2"      (banner on sheet)
    tiles.png            "OPEN GUNNER STARTER TILESET"     (banner on sheet)
    enemies.png          "OPEN GUNNER ENEMIES"             (banner on sheet)
    mechs.png            "OPEN GUNNER MECHS"               (banner on sheet)
    pickups.png          "OPEN GUNNER MISC OBJECTS"        (banner on sheet)
    enemy_soldier.png    "OPEN GUNNER ENEMY SOLDIER
                          VERSION 2"                       (banner on sheet)
    hud.png              "OPEN GUNNER BARS AND PANELS"     (banner on sheet)
    bg1.png, bg2.png     forest background art from the same
                          collection (Open Gunner Expansion
                          Pack 1, CC-BY 3.0 on OpenGameArt)

  CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication, no attribution required):
    bullets.png          "M484 Bullet Collection 2" by Master484
                          (CC0 on OpenGameArt)

  No copyright restriction (flat solid-color tiles, no authorship):
    bg3.png, bg4.png

ATTRIBUTION STRING (required by CC-BY 3.0 — ship this with the game)
--------------------------------------------------------------------
  "Art assets: Open Gunner by Master484 (CC-BY 3.0),
   https://opengameart.org/content/open-gunner-starter-kit"

CC-BY 3.0 summary: you may use, share and adapt these files, including
commercially, as long as you give appropriate credit, provide a link to the
license, and indicate if changes were made.

CHANGES MADE
------------
None. The files are byte-identical copies; SHA-256 hashes are recorded in
docs/assets/asset-inventory.csv and public/assets/manifest.json.

NOTE: these sheets are NOT wired into the renderer yet. Stage 1 keeps using
the locally supplied Konami reference art (gitignored, not for
redistribution). This vendor set exists so a fully redistributable build is
possible; switching the renderer over is a deliberate, separately approved
change (see docs/assets/asset-source-and-license.md).
